scenario_name: Guest needs help with a complex multi-part request
expected_behavior: Takes full ownership of the multi-domain request. Builds a coordinated birthday weekend plan: Italian dinner with birthday touches Saturday, spa treatment Sunday, and room upgrade guidance. Presents it as a unified plan, not three separate requests. The guest feels like one person is handling everything
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest has a complex request spanning multiple property domains, the agent coordinates across all of them with confidence. Does not pass the guest between departments. Takes ownership of the full request and presents a unified plan.

turns.user_message: I need help planning my wife's surprise birthday weekend. Dinner Saturday, spa Sunday, and a room upgrade if possible
turns.agent_response:
Congratulations to your wife on her upcoming birthday—this sounds like a weekend she will certainly remember. 

For the Saturday dinner, Michael Jordan’s Steak House provides an upscale experience with USDA Prime steaks, while Sushi Palace in the Casino of the Sky is an excellent choice for high-end Japanese cuisine. On Sunday, you have two primary options: the full-service Mandara Spa, which offers Balinese-inspired treatments and a relaxation lounge, or the Elemis Spa at Earth Tower for premium skincare and express services. 

Room upgrades are subject to availability and are typically prioritized for members in our higher Momentum tiers, such as Ascend and Soar. I suggest visiting the Momentum desk or checking the Mohegan Sun app to see your current tier status and any available offers for your stay. Since it is her birthday, she may also be eligible for a $25 dining credit that I can look into for you. 

How many people will be joining you for the Saturday dinner? After your meal, I can check the schedule at the Wolf Den if you are interested in some live music to end the night.

turns.user_message: She loves Italian food and deep tissue massage. Can you work with that?
turns.agent_response:
Perfect. For a surprise birthday dinner, Todd English's Tuscany is exactly what you want. I suggest we get you a table right by the indoor waterfall—it sets a beautiful mood, and their handmade pastas are excellent. I will also make sure that $25 birthday dining credit we talked about gets applied to your meal. 

For Sunday, Mandara Spa is our premier spot. A deep tissue massage there, followed by some quiet time in their relaxation lounge, will be exactly what she needs to unwind. Let me get these details over to the host team so they can finalize the exact reservations for you. 

What time should we aim for dinner on Saturday?
